condition_evidence.counts_preserved: items_total, visible, suppressed and unchanged came back agreeing
condition_evidence.cross_org_read_refused: a read for the same digest id under another organization returned nothing, with the same answer it gives for a digest that does not exist
condition_evidence.delivery_intent_references_a_persisted_d: an intent's digest_id resolves to a stored record - the gap Gate 150 found, where 71 intents named digests that existed nowhere
condition_evidence.honesty_fields_preserved: human review, unverified deadlines and unknown reporting burden survived the round trip
condition_evidence.payload_hash_stable: the stored sha256 equals a hash recomputed over the stored payload
condition_evidence.repository_round_trip: a digest was written and read back by its id
condition_evidence.table_exists: migration 0042 applied and the table is inspectable

what_this_does_not_mean: that any live source was called
that any real tenant's digest was stored
that production digest persistence is available
